row: Because You Care, Animal Rescue and Adoption

Mission:
 Because You Care believes in the value of all companion animals. 
As a progressive rescue and adoption organization, we adhere to the highest no-kill standards. We match rescued animals with their best possible fur-ever homes by investing in their health, rehabilitation, socialization, and well-being.
Our Vision:
 Because You Care is a leader in cat and dog rescue and adoption. 
We are committed to the safety and well-being of animals while they are in our care and throughout their lifetimes.
